correctness.rationale: The replacement retains the theorem and fixes the odd-ring remainder argument. The frozen proof's exact p_±=A(x)±B(x,φ) formula incorrectly makes the average flux independent; even winding harmonics are allowed there (already for n=3, the farthest-site cos(2φ) coefficient begins at −x^6/40). In the replacement, complex conjugation and reflection instead give p_j(φ,−t)=p_{−j}(φ,t) and the same exchange for flux derivatives. Each farthest-site FI quotient extends analytically at t=0 after factoring its x^{2r} denominator; the sum is even, so the order-2r+3 Taylor term vanishes. The winding phase (−i)^{nℓ} establishes the all-time blind sets. Shortest-path interference yields the stated coefficients, with all nearer-site terms bounded using |q|+|q'|≥n for distinct windings. The leading constants prove the converse at fixed nonexceptional flux. Commutation gives the QFI as 4t² times the variance of ∂φH in the input; the two distinct one-hop sites give variance 2J²/n² even for n=3. The repaired analysis applies to the pointwise ordinary score and not to limiting information at support zeros.
residual_risks: Small-time remainders are at fixed flux; no uniformity at exceptional flux or inference statement for limiting Hellinger information.

value.rationale: Resolved positions are a natural experimentally accessible readout. The exact blind fluxes and coefficient-bearing latency penalty distinguish that readout from rooted returns and from fixed-encoding QFI. The opposite parity powers and their farthest-site carriers quantify which outcomes matter before long-time dynamics, while the support-zero caution avoids claiming that first-order blindness prevents all inference.
